title: Wallpaper deletions are applied locally and not rolled back when TDLib refuses
trigger: Delete the account wallpaper / an installed wallpaper / a chat wallpaper while offline-ish or when the server errors.
effect: delete_default_background (94), remove_installed_background (119) and delete_chat_background (264) remove the entry on send; the error arm in chats/error.rs only sets background_error, so the wallpaper stays gone locally until a refetch/reopen although the server kept it.
fix: Apply on the answer (or keep a Removing stage that the error arm reverts).

title: Shared wallpaper link lands in the clipboard after the preview was left
trigger: Press Share in the wallpaper preview, close it (or open another wallpaper) before getBackgroundUrl answers.
effect: background_url is an ownerless Option slot cleared only when a preview opens/closes; the answer sets it afterwards and the poll drain copies it to the clipboard without checking that a preview for that background is still open.
fix: Match the answer to the preview that asked (request id in the preview) and drop it otherwise.

title: fetch_new_chat_privacy replaces a Ready value with Loading and has no dedupe
trigger: Open Privacy twice, or reopen while a set_new_chat_settings is in flight.
effect: The Ready value (with the paid-message price) becomes Loading, so set_new_chat_privacy is refused during the fetch; a fetch answer arriving after an optimistic set overwrites the new value with the old server one.
fix: Keep Ready while refreshing (Ready{refreshing}) and ignore a fetch answer older than the last set.

title: Cancel is only seen between body chunks, so a stalled server keeps the row Downloading for up to 180 s after the switch is turned off
trigger: Start a download on a flaky connection that stalls mid-body, flip the switch off.
effect: Switch toggles off in the OS-less sense but the row keeps Downloading n% and toggling again does nothing (toggle_dictionary returns early while download.code matches) until the 180 s global timeout.
fix: Add a Cancelling stage that the row shows at once and drop the download future (cancel the ureq call) instead of polling a flag.

title: A timed-out ISpellChecker check answers correct, and SpellChecker caches that answer
trigger: Type a misspelled word on Windows while the COM thread is busy loading a cold dictionary (over 5 s) or backlogged with jobs.
effect: The word gets no underline and stays unflagged (cached as correct) until the cache is cleared by learn/unlearn/set_app_words or 20k other words.
fix: Backend returns Option<bool> (Unknown on timeout) and SpellChecker caches only Known answers.

title: Blocked-senders pages are not matched to the list they extend
trigger: Open Blocked Users, scroll so page offset N is requested, then unblock someone (SetSenderBlockList drops the data) or reopen so the offset-0 fetch restarts; the old page answers last.
effect: The late page is appended without dedupe to a fresh list, or take_data() finds nothing, leaves the Fetch Idle and the list is lost until reopened; blocked_total is written by any page.
fix: Put a list generation in GetBlockedSenders { offset, generation } and drop answers of an older generation; dedupe on append.

title: A failed privacy set marks the key Failed whichever of several sets failed, and drops the real value
trigger: Change a privacy rule twice in quick succession (the second applies optimistically, both are in flight); the first one fails, or one fails on its own.
effect: The key becomes PrivacyKeyState::Failed ('Couldn't load') although the server kept the old or the second value; the row is not editable until the screen is reopened and refetched. A late getPrivacyRules answer for the same key also overwrites a newer optimistic Ready because answers are not matched to the newest request for the key.
fix: Per-key state {Loading(RequestId), Ready{detail, saving: Option<RequestId>}, Failed}; a set failure restores the previous detail and shows an error, and answers apply only for the key's live request id.

title: Late answer of the remembered-password check reopens the finish step after the user dismissed it
trigger: Type the password in 'Do you still remember your password?' and submit (password_check=Checking), close the box (dismiss_password_check sets Idle) before the getRecoveryEmailAddress answer comes.
effect: RecoveryEmailAddress sets Remembered (or the error arm sets Wrong or Failed) with no check that the box is still waiting for this request; the box shows the finish step or a wrong-password line the next time the page renders it.
fix: PasswordCheck::Checking { request: RequestId }; apply only when pending.id matches, and let dismiss drop the request.

title: A failed privacy set leaves the optimistic call privacy mirrored in calls state
trigger: Settings > Calls (or Privacy > Calls), change Who can call me; setUserPrivacySettingRules fails (e.g. PRIVACY_TOO_LONG).
effect: set_privacy_rules calls mirror_call_privacy(key, &detail) before the answer; the error arm only sets PrivacyKeyState::Failed, so calls.privacy_allow_calls / privacy_p2p keep the rejected value and the older call code reads it.
fix: Derive the call fields from settings.privacy on read instead of mirroring them, or restore them from the previous detail in the SetPrivacyRules error arm.

title: Old Apply error stays after editing the draft; error is not tied to a chat
trigger: Apply a change that TDLib refuses (not enough boosts server side). Error line shows. Change a swatch.
effect: edit_chat_appearance resets sent and needs_boosts but not the session-wide appearance_error, so the stale refusal stays under the new draft until the next Apply. The error is also unkeyed by chat: a late refusal for chat A shows in the box opened for chat B.
fix: Store the error in the Apply stage enum with the chat id and request id; clear it when the draft changes.

title: Apply sends part of a plan, reports failure, and a pack request is not tracked as busy
trigger: Change name colour and group emoji pack in a supergroup, Apply. Name request goes out, then set_supergroup_custom_emoji_sticker_set refuses (no rights / full info missing) and returns Err.
effect: Part of the plan is already applied but the note says could not change and dialog.sent=false. Conversely when the pack request is sent, busy covers only three purposes, so 'Appearance updated' shows while the pack request is in flight and its error never reaches appearance_error.
fix: Validate the whole plan before sending any part, and make the Apply stage one enum (Editing, NeedsBoosts, Applying{requests}, Applied, Failed(reason)) that counts all four request purposes.

title: Boost-level message for the wallpaper is written into the shared background_error
trigger: In a boosted supergroup open Appearance > Choose wallpaper, pick a wallpaper the chat has too few boosts for, Apply (blocked), close the box, open Settings > Wallpapers.
effect: boosted_look_blocked writes chats_state.background_error, which wallpaper_preview and telegram_wallpapers also render, so 'Level N required' or 'Checking the boost level' shows on unrelated pages and is only cleared by the next open/apply of one of them.
fix: Keep the gate message in the chat look dialog's own state (a variant of its Apply stage), not in the session-wide background error.

title: Language page opened before an account switch never asks the new account for the pack list
trigger: With the Settings window on Language, switch account from the main window: language.open is still Some (LanguageUi is app-level, not OnScreen), so ensure_language_box returns early and request_language_packs is not sent to the new session.
effect: The page shows 'No languages found' (packs empty, packs_loading false) until the user leaves and re-enters the page.
fix: Make the request part of a Fetch<Vec<LanguagePackInfo>> in the session that the page asks for whenever it is Idle, instead of a once-per-visit Option in app state.

title: Choosing a language rewrites the recent-languages file with packs the user just removed
trigger: Settings > Language: open the ... menu of a recent (non-official) pack and choose Delete (it dims, file written without it); then pick any other language row without leaving the page.
effect: install_language saves self.language.recent (which still holds the removed pack, filtered only in leave_language_settings), so the removed pack is written back and reappears in the list next visit.
fix: Apply a removal to LanguageUi::recent at once and keep only a 'dimmed for Restore' view in the box (Recent entry enum Kept/Removed), so every save writes one list.

title: Failed language list request shows 'No languages found' with no retry
trigger: Settings > Language while TDLib getLocalizationTargetInfo errors or the request send fails.
effect: packs_loading is cleared on error and packs stays empty, so the page claims no languages exist instead of an error; no retry until the page is left and re-entered.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<LanguagePackInfoData>> with a Failed variant that the page renders with a Retry.

title: Corner preview windows end only on hover-out
trigger: Notification settings > Position: hover or click a corner slot, then close the settings page (Esc, tab or window close) without moving off the slot.
effect: notify_corner_preview(None) is called only from the slot's on_hover(false), which cannot fire once the element is gone; the sample popups (no timeout) stay on screen in that corner and the real notifications stay dimmed (windows.demo target 0).
fix: Own the preview as one value (Option<ScreenCorner>) cleared when the page closes, or give the samples a drop/close hook.

title: Tray 'disable notifications' flips only the account on screen
trigger: Two accounts signed in; use the tray/menu 'Disable notifications' while account A is on screen.
effect: set_desktop_notifications writes live.driver.session.settings of A only; account B's session still has desktop_notifications = true and keeps notifying (session_apply_messages.rs:457), and the tray checkbox flips back when B is brought on screen.
fix: Make the tray toggle an app-wide pref, or apply it to every account's session.

title: apply_chat_mute clears the mute dialog's flags for whatever chat it shows and misses two of them
trigger: Open Notifications for chat A from a row menu (sound picker sub-view opens), press a mute preset; or swipe/menu-mute chat B while A's box is open in another window.
effect: apply_chat_mute (also called by swipe, profile rows, chat menus) sets mute_menu_open=false and mute_chat=None unconditionally, so it closes a box that was open for another chat; it leaves notif_sound_picker_open and mute_custom_open set (close_mute_menu clears them), so the next header Mute opens with the sound picker expanded.
fix: Make the mute box one Option<MuteBox{chat, view: Presets|Custom|Sounds, time_inputs}>; apply_chat_mute closes it only when it is for that chat, and close is one assignment.

title: Mute time inputs are always built against the main window
trigger: Open Mute > Custom from a chat window whose box is hosted in that window, or with the main window closed to the tray.
effect: queue_mute_time_inputs defers into main_window.handle and builds InputState with that window; the fields are drawn in the chat window's dialog (focus/blur subscriptions belong to the other window), and with no main window handle they are never created, so the Custom row silently does not show.
fix: Create the fields with the window that asked (the Asker's window) and key them to it.

title: Scope/reaction notification settings are sent as a whole object copied from the session cache, without an optimistic update
trigger: Defaults dialog: flip two switches of one scope (or reaction sources) faster than TDLib's update arrives.
effect: Each apply_* clones scope_notification_settings, changes one field and sends the full object; the cache changes only on the later updateScopeNotificationSettings, so the second send carries the old value of the first field and silently reverts it. Same in apply_reaction_source/sound/preview.
fix: Keep a pending patch per scope (request id + the fields changed) and rebase on it, or send only the changed field when TDLib allows.

title: A privacy rule whose save failed on the server is left Failed and every further edit in the open editor is silently ignored
trigger: Settings > Privacy > open a rule editor (e.g. Last seen); change a choice or add an exception while the server rejects the set (PRIVACY_TOO_LONG, flood, offline); then click another choice or Add user in the same editor.
effect: The row turns to 'Couldn't load', no radio is selected, no toast is shown (reducer comment says never toasts), and mutate_privacy_detail returns early for non-Ready so clicks do nothing and say nothing until the Privacy page is reopened (fetch_privacy).
fix: On a failed set, refetch the rule (like SetSenderBlockList does) or keep the last Ready detail in a PrivacyKeyState::Ready{detail, save: Fetch<()>} variant and show the error in the editor.

title: Undo of a reaction marks the entry Undone even when the toggle did nothing
trigger: Click Undo on a react entry when toggle_reaction returns early (react_premium_feature opens Premium instead) or there is no live client. mark_undone runs right after the call.
effect: The row reads Undone while the reaction is still on the message; Premium may open over Settings.
fix: Make toggle_reaction report whether it sent the change and mark the entry only then.

title: Undo of an agent's send marks the entry Undone although the delete was refused or failed
trigger: Agent sent a message that is no longer in the loaded history (agent_undo_for offers Undo for ids it cannot find, see its own comment). Click Undo, then Delete in the box. delete_selection filters or ConnectDriver::delete_selected refuses, shows an error note, and the on_ok handler still calls activity::mark_undone.
effect: The row shows the Undone tag and loses its Undo button while the message still exists in the chat.
fix: Have delete_selection return Result<Sent, Refused> and mark the entry only on Sent; better, mark it when the deleteMessages answer or the message-deleted update arrives.

title: Undo of an agent's message resets the user's forward draft and selection in an unrelated chat
trigger: In chat X tick messages to forward (ForwardStage::Selecting or the forward bar), open Settings > Agent access > Activity and Undo an agent send in chat Y. delete_selection ends with self.share.forward = ForwardStage::None.
effect: The user's forward in progress is silently dropped; only the agent's delete was asked for.
fix: Split delete_selection into the delete itself and the selection-mode exit, and clear the forward stage only when its draft is for the same chat and the same ids.

title: Activity filter outlives the account picked in the Chats section
trigger: Agent access page, Activity: filter by chat A of account 1. In the Chats section pick account 2 from the account menu (agent_ui.picked changes, filter does not). Account 2's log has no chat A.
effect: Activity shows 'nothing matches the filter' while the Chats button reads its default label (the chat is not in the new account's list), so no filter looks active; the user must find 'All' in the menu. The same stale filter also applies when picked changes back.
fix: Make the filter part of one value with the account it was made for (e.g. picked: Option<(AccountKey, ActivityFilter)>), or reset the filter wherever picked changes.

title: Log out box closes as if it worked when the logout request could not be sent
trigger: Settings > Account > Log out, press Log out while the send fails (request_logout returns Err) or there is no live client. The button handler clears settings.log_out_confirm and then calls close_kit_dialog_if_done unconditionally.
effect: submit_logout's own comment says a failed send must not silently close the dialog, but this box closes anyway; the user sees only a transient error note (or nothing with no live client) and believes the logout started.
fix: Make submit_logout return whether the request went out and clear log_out_confirm and close the box only on success; keep the box with an inline error otherwise.

title: Contact chooser sends to whatever chat is open when a contact is clicked, not the chat it was opened for
trigger: Open Attach > Contact in chat A; before the click, chat B comes to the front in the same window (notification click, link, agent open, Saved Messages jump). Click a contact. submit_share_contact reads share_target() from session.open_chat, and nothing closes content_dialog on a chat change.
effect: The contact card goes to chat B, possibly one the user never meant to share a phone number with (privacy and wrong-target).
fix: Put the destination (AccountChat/ChatId) inside ShareContentDialog when it opens, send to that, and close the dialog in the chat-switch path.

title: Composer spelling and edit menu in a chat window is built from the main window's composer
trigger: Right click a misspelled word in a chat window's composer. composer_context_menu defers build_composer_menu with window.defer, outside in_window_scope, so app.composer, chat_ui and spell state are the main window's.
effect: Suggestions, Cut/Copy enablement, the code-block and emoji items come from the main composer text and selection; the replace is refused or applies to nothing.
fix: Capture the window scope at right-click time and run build_composer_menu inside in_window_scope(scope).

title: If the wallpaper worker thread panics, every wallpaper area asks for an animation frame forever
trigger: Open a chat whose wallpaper render panics in Sources::render (e.g. a malformed pattern/photo that trips image/resvg); spawn_guarded catches the panic and the thread ends.
effect: Shared::threaded stays true, Board::running/wanted keep the dead job, nothing ever finishes, so lookup returns pending=true and request_animation_frame runs every frame in every window showing a non-solid wallpaper (CPU/battery drain) and the wallpaper never draws.
fix: Make the worker's liveness a value (Worker::Running/Dead) set when the guarded body returns, and fall back to inline rendering or a plain fill (no further frame requests) when it is dead.

title: Wallpaper preview Apply closes the box and switches to the Telegram wallpaper before setDefaultBackground answers
trigger: Settings > Chat wallpaper > pick a gallery wallpaper (or From file...) > Apply while the request will fail (e.g. offline flood wait, upload of a local file refused).
effect: The box closes as if saved; appearance.telegram_wallpaper is set true and wallpaper_rgb is cleared even though the server never set the wallpaper, so the chosen preset color is lost and the old Telegram wallpaper shows; the error only lands in chats_state.background_error, which the closed preview no longer shows.
fix: Keep the preview open in an Applying { request } stage of the preview value and close it (and flip the appearance) only on the matching setDefaultBackground answer; show the error in the box on failure.

title: Wallpaper Share link is copied whenever any getBackgroundUrl answer lands, not matched to the preview that asked
trigger: Open wallpaper A's preview, press Share, press Cancel before the link arrives (or open wallpaper B's preview); the getBackgroundUrl answer for A lands.
effect: close/open clear background_url only before the answer; the late answer sets chats_state.background_url and drain_wallpaper_preview copies A's link to the clipboard (overwriting what the user copied) and, if B's preview is open, shows 'Link copied' under B.
fix: Record the getBackgroundUrl RequestId in the preview (a Sharing { request } stage) and apply the URL only when its request id matches the open preview's.
